notes: Large church noticeboard over a gate in Bukoto, Kampala, seen from below. Only the title is the target; the service-time table, 'Other Programs' list and the footer ('St Andrews Bukoto | We are Fisher's of Men | St Andrews Church Bukoto-COU') are secondary text. The sign uses a typographic apostrophe (’), transcribed as ASCII.

author: Elisha Muwanguzi
attribution: Photo: Elisha Muwanguzi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_Street_Sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow KCCA street-name sign with a left arrow on two posts, Kampala. The tiny KCCA logo, date '14/07/17' and serial 'SN 0026' in the corners are not part of the name. Lamp-post adverts in the background are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: BalukuBrian
attribution: Photo: BalukuBrian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ST._DANIEL_COMBONI_HOSPITAL_KYAMUHUNGA_UGANDA_SIGN_POST_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hospital signpost at Kyamuhunga (Bushenyi District), seen from below; 'Safe Journey' is on a separate top panel. The long bilingual English/Runyankore 'SERVICES OFFERED (OBUHEREZA BWEITU)' list, the phone/email footer and a faded P.O. Box line are secondary text left out of lines. People walking behind are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:ST. DANIEL COMBONI HOSPITAL KYAMUHUNGA UGANDA SIGN POST 01.jpg

author: Jozef020

notes: Weathered signpost at the council gate, Masindi; 'HEAD OFFICES' sits between painted arrow bars pointing right. Older painted-over lettering ghosts behind 'COUNCIL'. The seal text ('MASINDI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL') is small and left out. The sign spaces 'P.O. Box 192 , MASINDI' with a space before the comma. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: English/Luganda name plate on a wall, Kabubbu, Wakiso District. The sign uses typographic apostrophes (’), transcribed as ASCII. The crest text ('KABUBBU COMMUNITY LIBRARY / EDUCATING THE GENERATION!') and the faint steel dedication plaque below are left out. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: White signpost with the Ugandan coat of arms at right, mid-distance (about 170 px wide). The UCC (Uganda Communications Commission) logo text is tiny and left out. The fascia lettering 'ORTAL CITY PUBLICLIBRARY' at left (cut off by the frame) and the pink 'BEAUTY SALON' in the background are distractors; car number plates are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: Where the River Roars and the Heart Soars

notes: Printed entrance board on a fence at Itanda Falls (Nile, near Jinja). The entrance-fee table ('Entree Fee', UGX/USD prices) and 'Welcome Feel at Home' are secondary text left out of lines. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Itanda Falls Entrance Sign – Where the River Roars.jpg

author: Todd Huffman
attribution: Photo: Todd Huffman, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/99287245@N00/4787516794. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted school signboard on a brick wall, Kampala. The box number and phone sit at left beside 'School'; reading order is approximate. A cut-off banner at the left edge is a distractor.

author: Lneruba
attribution: Photo: Lneruba, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Uganda_Museum_Signage.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Round hanging sign in a ring frame outside the Uganda Museum, Kampala, seen from below. The photo has a strong green/cyan colour filter; a banana leaf crosses just under 'MUSEUM' without hiding letters.

author: Jozef020
attribution: Photo: Jozef020, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AKIM_medical_ltd.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Printed pharmacy fascia over a shop door in Kigumba, Kiryandongo District, in a very tall frame (sign occupies the upper third). Lowercase 'kiryandongo' as printed, and the bottom of that line is slightly clipped by the panel edge; the last phone digit touches the right edge. The man in the doorway is incidental; the stock photo of a doctor and child is part of the sign artwork.

author: BalukuBrian
attribution: Photo: BalukuBrian, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:St._Mary%27s_Vocational_school_Kyamuhunga_sign_post.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue-bordered school direction board with a crest and a red right arrow, shot upward through barbed wire, Bushenyi District. A banana leaf overlaps the top-right corner (the apostrophe and S of MARY'S are shaded) and a barbed-wire strand crosses the motto line. The crest repeats the name and motto in tiny text.
source_title: File:St. Mary's Vocational school Kyamuhunga sign post.jpg

author: SuSanA Secretariat
attribution: Photo: SuSanA Secretariat, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:011_8_swTws_Project_signboard,_Kisoro_1999_(7928188334).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: KISORO TOWN WATER AND SANITATION OFFICE

expect.query: Kisoro Town Water and Sanitation Office

notes: Stencil-lettered office board on a metal frame in Kisoro (1999). 'Austrain' is the sign's own misspelling of 'Austrian'. The SWTWS logo at the right has tiny text ('AMAIZI MARUNGI', 'South Western Towns Water & Sanitation UGANDA - AUSTRIA') not transcribed beyond the header. Alternative query: 'KITOWASO'.

author: BombyxMori
attribution: Photo: BombyxMori, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Entebbe_UVRI_sign_post.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stack of white boards at the UVRI gate, Entebbe, at an angle. Target is the top panel; the lower panels (collaborative programmes: MRC/UVRI, Rakai Health Sciences Programme, IAVI, CDC Uganda, WHO/EPI) and the 'STOP SECURITY CHECK' plate are distractors. The phone line is partly cut at the left edge of the board ('TEL:' is clear). Alternative query: 'Nakiwogo Road' (street).
